name: ColumnStrip
description: On a phone: columns a screen wide in a strip swiped with snap, under a row of pills (label and count) that follow the swipe and jump to a column on a tap. While a SortableGroup card is held, resting at either edge of the strip (on a phone, the screen's) pages the strip one column after a dwell, then on a repeat, by a transform (never a scroll), restored to the same scroll position on drop.
usage: Wire it to the SortableGroup around it with useColumnStrip(): pass the hook's onDragChange and onDragMove to the group and the hook's object to the strip as `drag`
`pageable` limits paging to the columns a card may land in
Controlled with `current` + `onCurrentChange` (keys); a new `current` scrolls there. Uncontrolled with `defaultCurrent`
`pillsClassName` styles the pills' row (sticky, a border); `pillsEnd` puts something at its end
examples:
const drag = useColumnStrip();
<SortableGroup onMove={move} onDragChange={drag.onDragChange} onDragMove={drag.onDragMove}>
  <ColumnStrip drag={drag} pageable={['ideas', 'queued']} columns={[
    { key: 'ideas', label: 'Ideas', count: 3, content: <SortableList id="ideas" … /> },
    { key: 'queued', label: 'Queued', count: 1, content: <SortableList id="queued" … /> },
  ]} />
</SortableGroup>
design: The strip is as tall as the column in view, so the page scrolls it as one
A page slides on recipe.sheetIn's easing at duration.arrival (620 ms): easing out, no overshoot (like the iPhone's home screen)
The cue: a 24 px glow of --color-text-link at the paging edge, building linearly over the dwell
Defaults: edge 56 px, dwell 500 ms, repeat 600 ms
Only the column in view sets the strip's height; the others are clipped to it, so the strip never scrolls up and down
accessibility: The pills are buttons in a nav (label `label`, default "Columns"); the current one has aria-current=true
Each column is a region named by its label when the label is a string
Under Reduce Motion pill jumps and pages are instant and the cue shows at full strength

props.name: current
props.description: The column in view, by key (controlled)

props.name: onCurrentChange
props.description: A new column came into view (a swipe, a pill, a page)

props.name: pageable
props.description: The columns a held card may page to

props.name: drag
props.description: From useColumnStrip(); without it, no edge paging

props.name: edge
props.description: Each edge zone's width, px, inside the strip's left and right edges (past an edge counts as in it)

props.name: dwell
props.description: ms resting in an edge zone before the first page

props.name: repeat
props.description: ms between pages while the finger stays

props.name: pillsEnd
props.description: At the end of the pills' row
